empty.body: When something needs your attention, it will show up here.

prefs.title: Notification preferences
prefs.intro: Choose what you want to receive. You can enable or mute as many categories as you like — changes are saved automatically when you click.
prefs.enabledHint: Turn off to pause all notifications. The categories below keep your choices for when you turn it back on.
prefs.categoriesHint: Check to receive; uncheck to mute. Notifications from muted categories are not hidden — they arrive already marked as muted.
